opportunities.name: Search Ryanair flights by route, dates and passengers
opportunities.description: Search one-way or return Ryanair flights from a departure airport to a destination airport on chosen dates for a chosen number of passengers, optionally applying a promo code.
steps: Open ryanair.com and make sure the Flights tab is active.
Choose trip type (Return trip or One way).
Click the From field, choose the origin country and then the origin airport (e.g. Dublin).
Click the To field, choose the destination country and then the destination airport.
Click the Depart field, open the right month in the calendar and click the departure day.
If return trip, click the Return field and click the return day.
Click the Passengers field and set Adults / Teens / Children / Infants with the +/- controls, then click Done.
Optionally click Apply promo code and enter the code.
Click Search and wait for the flight results page.
parameters: destination airport (e.g. Athens, Malta, Paris Beauvais, Venice Treviso)
number of adults and other passengers

Tel Aviv to Venice Treviso; depart Tue 9 May, return Tue 16 May; 1 adult

opportunities.name: Search Booking.com attractions by destination and date, then book tickets
opportunities.description: Find tours or attractions in a city on Booking.com for a given date, apply filters, open an activity and choose a ticket count for a date.
steps: Open booking.com and click the Attractions tab.
Type the city or attraction name in the search box and pick it from the suggestions (or click a destination tile such as Kyoto).
Click the dates field, pick the target date in the calendar and click Search.
Optionally tick filters (e.g. Free cancellation, Tours category, city) and sort by Most popular.
Open the target activity from the results list.
Click Show more dates or the date picker, choose the date, then set ticket counts (Adult, Child, Infant) and click Next.

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris; date 5 May 2023; 1 adult ticket viewed
Kyoto; date 25 May 2023; filters free cancellation, Tours, Kyoto; activity Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour; 2 adults, 1 infant

opportunities.name: Find Resy restaurant, check slots and set a notify request
opportunities.description: Switch Resy to a city, search for a restaurant by name or cuisine, open it, choose a date and party size, and if no slot fits set a Notify request for a time window.
steps: Click the city selector at the top and choose the city (or pick it from Popular Cities).
Click the search box and type a restaurant name or cuisine, then pick the matching result.
On the restaurant page, click the date control and choose the date; set the party size in Guests if needed.
If the wanted time slot is unavailable, click Notify beside the meal period or time slot.
In the Set Notify dialog, choose the preferred start and end times and click Confirm.
parameters: restaurant name or cuisine term (e.g. thai, high tide, pasta)
notify time window (start and end time)

instances.values: Columbus, OH; search 'thai'; Senyai Thai Kitchen; Thu Apr 6, 2 guests; notify 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Miami search 'high tide' -> High Tide (Dumbo); date Fri Apr 21 then Mon Apr 17; 2 guests; lunch Notify
Sydney; search 'pasta'; result list for Pasta Emilia, party of 2

opportunities.name: Look up an artist's concert dates on SeatGeek and filter by date
opportunities.description: Search an artist or team on SeatGeek, open the performer page and filter its event list by a date range.
steps: Click the search box on the SeatGeek home page and type the artist name.
Pick the artist from the top result.
On the performer page, click Filter by Date.
Pick the start and end dates in the calendar and click Apply.

instances.values: Coldplay; no date filter applied yet; Columbus OH location
Coldplay; calendar range ending 17 May 2023 with Apply
